# Protocol fixtures

Files named `real_*_sanitized.json` are reduced from verified server captures in
the repository's reverse-engineering evidence. Account names, player-controlled
names, original instance IDs, timestamps, and unrelated account assets were
removed or replaced. Protocol keys, nesting, nulls, array shapes, and value
types used by parsers are preserved.

Synthetic edge fixtures are named by the condition they exercise and are not
presented as captured server responses.
